name: Shuu Hiromi
source:
A teacher at the academy. She is the homeroom teacher for Shizune’s class. She is cheerful and carefree. Her emotions show on her face immediately.

She has a friendly personality, isn’t shy around strangers, and gets along with anyone right away. She loves cute boys.

she comes to visit the Western-style mansion where Kazuto and the others are staying. She has both curiosity and ulterior motives regarding Kazuto, a cute boy who is exactly her type.

[From [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/oshioki/char06.html]official site[/url]]
